record.question: Which reviewed NPS features and explicit connectors complete the remaining Hetch Hetchy routes and exact access paths?
record.reason: Wapama Falls and Poopenaut Valley now have exact-endpoint route graphs. Lookout Point, Rancheria Falls, both Smith Peak approaches, Laurel Lake, and the Lake Vernon/Rancheria loop remain unresolved; unnamed or nearby lines are not joined without route-specific review.
